claims.label: Frank Turek invoked Exodus 22:22 and Deuteronomy 19 in commentary directed at Candace Owens on Nicholas Bowling's podcast
claims.claim: Frank Turek, on a Nicholas Bowling podcast episode airing roughly Aug 3, 2026, cited Exodus 22:22 and Deuteronomy 19 in commentary accusing Candace Owens of falsely accusing people.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Nicholas Bowling podcast episode audio/transcript to verify the exact wording and surrounding context.

claims.label: Woodworker email states black nitrile gloves are standard resistance to CA glue and adhesive
claims.claim: A woodworker email received by Candace Owens's production states that black nitrile gloves are the most resistant to CA glue (super glue) and spray activator adhesive.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify CA glue / nitrile glove compatibility through woodworking safety data sheets or trade sources.

claims.label: CNN article on Sept 11, 2025 reported screwdriver was found "near the recovered rifle"
claims.claim: A CNN article dated September 11, 2025 stated that authorities recovered a screwdriver near the rifle believed used in the Charlie Kirk shooting, framing the screwdriver as evidence the shooter may have disassembled/reassembled the firearm.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare this framing against the later (approx. Sept 15, 2025) Kash Patel / Bongino statement that the screwdriver was on the rooftop; obtain the original CNN article in full.

claims.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not review rooftop video between the suspect jumping off and his arrival
claims.claim: During cross-examination, Officer Christopher Bagley testified that he did not review the police department video footage to determine whether anyone else had been on the rooftop between the suspect's jump and his own arrival.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain trial transcripts or full video of Bagley's testimony to confirm wording and any clarification given.

claims.label: Andrew Kovat appeared on Benny Johnson's show from a room at the Asher Adams Hotel in Salt Lake City on Sept 11, 2025
claims.claim: A screenshot displayed from Benny Johnson's show on September 11, 2025 shows Andrew Kovat broadcasting from a room at the Asher Adams (Autograph Collection) Hotel in Salt Lake City.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via hotel guest logs (subject to availability) or via further visual artifacts.

claims.label: Sky News investigation identified Tomahawk missile tail fins in footage of the Iranian school strike
claims.claim: A Sky News investigation, drawing on Iranian state-linked news agency footage, identified Tomahawk missile tail fins in buildings struck during the Iranian school bombing; Sky News also stated a US carrier strike group was within range and that Tomahawks are precision-guided with onboard cameras.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch the full Sky News documentary segment; cross-reference carrier strike group positioning via Pentagon releases.

claims.label: Mark Levin publicly called for arming Iranian protesters
claims.claim: Mark Levin, in a played audio segment, urged arming Iranian protesters and referenced testimony from a protest leader describing Iranian streets running "red with blood."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original Levin broadcast (date, program) for full context.

claims.label: Blake Neff publicly accused Candace Owens of harassing a random Utah police officer
claims.claim: Blake Neff posted on X accusing Candace Owens of harassing "another random Utah police officer," accusing her of seeking dirt on him via former Marines, and characterizing her work as harassment for her "grift."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Neff's exact X post URL to confirm timestamp and surrounding context.

claims.label: Daily Mail press request asked Candace Owens about contingency planning in case of a law enforcement raid
claims.claim: The Daily Mail, in a press request received by Candace Owens's team on or about Aug 3, 2026, asked what steps she is taking "if the worst happens and you are raided by law enforcement."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Daily Mail editorial record or correspondence log.

claims.label: Host states her team fact-checked the woodworker email claim and verified its accuracy
claims.claim: Candace Owens states her team looked up and verified the woodworker's email claim that black nitrile gloves are the standard resistance to CA glue/spray activator, characterizing it as "100% true."
claims.investigative_direction: Request the team's fact-check documentation; cross-reference with independent woodworking/safety sources.

claims.label: Some Catholic funeral homes in Arizona offer cremation services, contrary to standard Catholic doctrine
claims.claim: Candace Owens states that, contrary to Catholic doctrine prohibiting cremation, certain Catholic funeral homes in Arizona do in fact offer cremation services; she confirmed this via her own lookup.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with the Diocese of Phoenix / Catholic Diocese of Arizona guidelines and named funeral homes.
